name: is-what
description: JS type check (TypeScript supported) functions like `isPlainObject() isArray()` etc. A simple & small integration.

scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm test && bumpp --no-push --all && pnpm publish --no-git-checks && jsr publish ${JSR_TOKEN:+--token $JSR_TOKEN} && git push --follow-tags && gh release create $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0) --generate-notes --notes "$(git log --pretty='- %s  %h' $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)..HEAD~1)"
